Class TamedDinosaur

java.lang.Object
gamemode.lobby.Item.Base.Item
gamemode.lobby.Item.Base.TamedDinosaur
All Implemented Interfaces:
Sellable
public class TamedDinosaur extends Item implements Sellable
Represents a tamed dinosaur that can be treated as a sellable item.

A TamedDinosaur wraps a Dinosaur entity and allows it to be stored in the inventory and sold in the shop system.

The sell price is derived from the original dinosaur's sell value at the time of taming.
